next_step: Sign-off dedicated POC plan and schedule canary start (2-week): confirm model variants, routing & rollback SLAs
notes:
CRM notes: Mid-market product analytics vendor evaluating Redwood for semantic search + support chat. Key contacts: CTO Maya Rios; product lead Aaron Kim. Started with Hosted API (fast integration) -> positive perf on short test queries; now moving to Dedicated POC for production characteristics.

Summary:
- workload: embeddings-heavy semantic search + chat support for product docs (mixed short/long seq).
- targets: p95 latency <= 150ms for chat prompt+response (small responses), embeddings throughput 500 reqs/min, cost sensitivity moderate (aim for unit < $0.002/embedding).
- models: prefer open Llama family variants; want quantized candidate for cost bench + FP16 for quality checks. Interested in Redwood's verified profiles.
- routing: need canary + steady rollout: 10% traffic to Dedicated canary for 1 week, then 50% then 100%. Fallback policy: if canary error rate > 1% or latency p95 > 250ms or eval-quality drop > 3 points revert to previous model or hosted fallback.
- region failover: primary us-east dedicated pool; failover to us-west and hosted API in GCP region eu-west for cross-region outages. DNS + policy-based routing; automated escalation to AE/SE on failover.
- rollback: manual + auto-triggers (latency, error-rate, evaluation regression on pre-defined prompt set). Keep last-2 model snapshots for fast rollback.
- observability: need token-level cost breakdown, trace ids for traces, per-route dashboards. SE runthrough confirmed Redwood Console shows these metrics in canary window.

Timeline / Recent activity:
- 2026-01-20: Lead created (POC request).
- 2026-02-12: Hosted API demo (Jordan + Priya) — fast onboarding, "integration < 1 day" per devs.
- 2026-02-18: Scoping call (fireflies ff_2026-02-18_Intro-and-PoC-scope) — agreed POC objectives and evaluation metrics.

- Next: kickoff Dedicated POC (2 weeks) scheduled after budget ok.

POC plan (agreed):
- Duration: 2 weeks canary + 1 week ramp.
- Canary traffic: start 10% -> monitor 7 days -> escalate to 50% if no regressions.
- Models: test two variants: quantized int8 (cost baseline) and fp16 for quality. Eval harness runs nightly on 120 prompts.
- Fallbacks: hosted smaller model (gpt-small-like) + region failover to us-west dedicated pool then hosted API.
- Success criteria: no QoE regression >3 points, p95 latency <= 200ms, error-rate <1%, embedding recall within 2% of baseline.
- Rollback steps documented in POC runbook (drive link).
